sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We refer to our current proposal for your business. Please be advised that our offer stands at a price of €370.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

Without movement from your side we cannot move either. Kindly note that this position remains firm within our process guidelines, and our offer stays valid for 30 days.

We look forward to receiving your response on how you wish to proceed.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
